title: The Chalkbone Spear
summary: Something to carry out of the Rings that reaches further than the cleaver does.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now work a chalkbone bar and a pair of chalk spurs into a spear, stab where the cleaver is slash, and longer besides.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking chalk spurs, for anyone who would rather buy than dig one out of whatever used to walk on it.

items.name: Chalkbone spear
items.examine: Ground down from a chalkbone bar into a point. Better at a distance you can still see coming.
